skills.name: fetch_available_agents
skills.description: Connects to Azure AI Foundry and retrieves all available agents registered in the project. Filters agents based on their capabilities and active status.

input.prompt: The user prompt to help filter relevant agents by domain

skills.output: List of AgentInfo objects containing agent metadata, capabilities, and MCP server endpoints

skills.name: select_best_agent
skills.description: Analyzes the user prompt and available agents to select the most appropriate 1-2 agents. Computes a heuristic relevance score per agent (name/description keyword match, capability match, user preference match, and historical usage bonus from the vector store), then passes the top-ranked candidates and their scores to a Foundry LLM (AzureFoundry:SelectorAgentId) to make the final pick. Falls back to the heuristic ranking alone if no selector agent is configured or the call fails.

input.agents: List of available agents from fetch_available_agents
input.userContext: User preferences, past interactions, and stored embeddings

skills.output: Ranked list of best-matching AgentInfo objects (max 2)
selectionCriteria: Agent capability match with prompt domain
User's historical preference for specific providers
Final LLM-assisted selection via AzureFoundry:SelectorAgentId, informed by heuristic scores

skills.name: execute_agent_action
skills.description: Invokes the selected Foundry agent via its MCP server endpoint. Passes the enriched prompt (with user context and preferences) to the agent and retrieves structured results such as flight options, pricing, and availability.

input.prompt: The enriched prompt with user context

skills.output: Structured response from the agent containing options, pricing, and details

skills.name: confirm_booking
skills.description: Sends a confirmation request to the selected agent's MCP server. The agent processes the booking through the provider's system (e.g., Air India, Emirates) and returns confirmation details including booking ID, itinerary, and status.
skills.output: ConfirmationDetails with booking ID, provider, and itinerary summary

skills.name: store_context_embedding
skills.description: Stores processed interaction data as vector embeddings in the user's personal vector store. This enables RAG-based retrieval for future interactions, allowing the system to remember preferences like preferred airlines, seat types, meal choices, and travel times.
skills.output: Confirmation that embedding was stored successfully
